title: Felipe de León Sáenz Angel
text:
About
I am currently based at the Laboratoire de Mathématiques d’Orsay (LMO), Université Paris-Saclay. My current position is funded by the CAPES/Cofecub program. I completed my PhD in Mathematics in February 2026 at the Instituto de Matemática Pura e Aplicada (IMPA), under the supervision of Eduardo Esteves.
Before joining LMO, I was a research assistant at the Universidad de Santiago de Chile, working with Nicolas Thériault. This position was funded by DICYT.
My research lies at the intersection of algebraic geometry, quiver representations, and tropical and polyhedral geometry. I am particularly interested in degenerations of linear series, linked projective spaces, and Mustafin varieties.

text:
Publications

Polymatroidal tilings and the Chow class of linked projective spaces
with Eduardo Esteves
Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society 58 (2026), e70370.
We use polymatroidal tilings to compute the Chow class of a linked projective space and prove that it has the same Chow class as the small diagonal.

Journal · DOI · arXiv



On the Hilbert polynomial of the linked projective space
with Eduardo Esteves and Eduardo Vital
arXiv:2609.37634 (2026).
We prove that linked projective spaces have the multivariate Hilbert polynomial of the small diagonal. The proof combines a Hilbert-polynomial formula for simple normal-crossings schemes with the polymatroidal tiling associated with a linked net.
